observations: PreparationReceipt sets authority_effect to none and records credential creation only as local_effect.
ReconciliationReceipt sets authority_effect to none and separates local journal activity from observed finalized-status reads.
TrialEvidence sets authority_effect to none and records Devnet activity only as observed_external_effect.
All three runtime receipt classes state authorization_attestation as external-not-attested-by-runner.
The attempt journal uses operator-invoked-execution-start rather than authorized-execution-start.
The trial claim ceiling describes an operator-invoked run after an external decision and does not claim the runner authenticated or attested authority.
A source-bound regression rejects the authority-inflating predecessor strings and both frozen D65 cycles record the workspace test suite passing.
authority_claim_repair.bounded_interpretation: The implementation no longer represents an observed or local effect as authority. This verifies terminology and claim separation only; it does not authenticate the external operator decision.

observations: The effectful runner and reconciliation commands write directly to their output files and are followed by separate jq inspection commands.
The guide contains no tee pipeline capable of replacing the runner exit status with tee success.
The guide retains stop-on-first-effectful-error and no-resubmission reconciliation instructions.

focused_test_attempt.reason: An independent focused cargo test rebuild was interrupted before test execution when the parent requested immediate finalization. No PASS is inferred from that attempt; the frozen stable-cycle receipt separately records two completed passing workspace cycles.

predecessor_finding_dispositions.evidence: Runtime-generated preparation, reconciliation and trial receipts now hold authority_effect at none, separate local or observed external effects, explicitly decline authorization attestation, and no longer use the authority-inflating journal or claim strings.
The guide no longer pipes runner or reconciliation execution through tee; output redirection preserves the executable exit code and jq is invoked separately.
